# Birla RootX

> Birla RootX is a performance supplement brand with five products in its Performance Series. Each product is currently listed at ₹1,999 on birlarootx.com.

Important: Product information on this website is based on supplied front-pack images. Full ingredients, directions, warnings, allergen information, and other regulated label details should be taken from the complete physical product label.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://birlarootx.com/): Brand overview and the complete five-product Performance Series.
- [Carbs Slayer](https://birlarootx.com/product.html?product=carbs-slayer): 60-capsule product page.
- [Jacked Pre-Workout](https://birlarootx.com/product.html?product=jacked-pre-workout): 40-scoop pre-workout product page.
- [Spilan Test](https://birlarootx.com/product.html?product=spilan-test): 60-capsule product page.
- [Epic Burn Pro](https://birlarootx.com/product.html?product=epic-burn-pro): 60-capsule product page.
- [Growth Factor](https://birlarootx.com/product.html?product=growth-factor): 60-capsule product page.
